name: Zero One
author: zhou-jianwen
variant_note: An independently AI-generated compact 3D-toy V2 interpretation of the school-uniform character reference in request #308, with nine task animations and sixteen clockwise look directions. The request name is preserved while the reference's different lettering remains unresolved.
description: An independently AI-generated, non-commercial companion with long lavender hair, violet eyes, asymmetric floral hair ornaments, a white blouse, navy bow and skirt, dark socks, and lavender shoes. The requested name Zero One / 零一 is retained; no franchise, creator ownership, or original-character status is asserted.
source_notes: The requester-supplied character sheet (https://api.codexpet.top/uploads/reference/references/c70f93689b47ac84504ba6f48127a5f952464f9f733e5bcc492e48120cacff49.png) was used only as an appearance reference for its school-uniform outfit. The Issue names the character 零一, while the sheet lettering reads 零依 / 依依; that identity mismatch is unresolved. The source artist, franchise, and redistribution permission are unverified. The submitter's production decision is an independent, non-commercial, reference-only AI interpretation: no reference pixels are copied, and zhou-jianwen is credited only as the AI-assisted adapter. Sprite pixels were generated with the built-in image_gen tool, then processed through native-alpha extraction, whole-pose retiling for spacing, and deterministic shared-scale V2 assembly. Left and right locomotion were generated separately to preserve asymmetric accessories; no character mirroring was used. This production decision does not assert maintainer acceptance or underlying rights.
